title: Thermal-Hydraulics and Safety Analysis Engineer - Isotopes
description:
Thanks for your interest in Oklo!  We are searching for a Thermal-Hydraulics and Safety Analysis Engineer to join our isotope engineering team to own the thermal hydraulic safety case for the next generation of domestic isotope production facilities.

Position Description

The Thermal-Hydraulics and Safety Analysis Engineer is responsible for developing and executing systems-level thermal-hydraulic analyses that support the safety case, design basis, and licensing of Oklo's reactor systems. This engineer will evaluate reactor and plant response during normal operation, anticipated operational occurrences, and postulated accident conditions using codes such as RELAP5 and other systems-analysis tools.

This role combines hands-on transient modeling with safety-methodology development. The engineer will establish modeling approaches, assess code and model applicability, quantify uncertainty, and produce clear, auditable technical documentation suitable for licensing applications and regulatory review. The engineer will work closely with safety, licensing, reactor physics, thermal-hydraulics, controls, and system-design teams to connect analysis assumptions and acceptance criteria to an evolving reactor design.

This position is focused on thermal-hydraulic safety analysis and licensing support. It does not own source-term, radiological-consequence, or severe-accident progression analysis, although collaboration with engineers performing those analyses may be required.

The isotope engineering team is a small but growing team, so the candidate must be capable of operating in a highly iterative and independent environment.

Specific responsibilities may include:

•
Develop, maintain, and execute systems-level thermal-hydraulic models of reactor and plant behavior using RELAP5 or comparable analysis codes.

•
Analyze normal operating conditions, anticipated operational occurrences, design-basis events, and selected beyond-design-basis conditions relevant to the thermal-hydraulic safety case.

•
Develop event-specific analysis plans, including initial and boundary conditions, assumptions, acceptance criteria, figures of merit, and treatment of uncertainties.

•
Develop and document thermal-hydraulic safety-analysis methods, modeling guidance, and engineering practices appropriate to advanced reactor licensing.

•
Establish and justify code, model, and correlation applicability for the physical phenomena and operating regimes being evaluated.

•
Perform model verification, validation, sensitivity studies, uncertainty analyses, scaling evaluations, and comparisons with experiments, benchmarks, hand calculations, or higher-fidelity analyses. Identify gaps in available methods, data, and validation evidence, and define practical plans to close those gaps.

•
Translate regulatory requirements and safety acceptance criteria into defensible analysis requirements and technical evaluation strategies.

•
Prepare high-quality calculation packages, methodology documents, safety-analysis reports, licensing-application content, and responses to regulator questions.

•
Evaluate design changes and provide timely feedback on their effects on transient response, safety margins, system performance, and the licensing basis.

•
Collaborate with reactor physics, fuel, controls, mechanical, thermal-hydraulics, safety, and licensing engineers on coupled analyses and interface conditions.

•
Develop scripts and automated workflows for model generation, execution, post-processing, regression testing, and configuration control.

•
Review safety analyses and models prepared by internal contributors, vendors, and external partners.

Minimum Qualifications:

•
Bachelor's, master's, or doctoral degree in nuclear, mechanical, chemical, or aerospace engineering, or a closely related technical field.

•

title: Thruster CAD and Stress Analyst
description: Here at The Exploration Company, we are building innovative aerospace technologies that advance the future of space transportation. The heart of a spacecraft lies in its propulsion system, and that's why we, at The Exploration Company, are dedicated to developing our own cutting-edge Propulsion Systems ensuring the highest level of efficiency and reliability in our space endeavours. We want you as a talented CAD & Stress Analyst to help us in our mission by designing and structurally justifying the hardware that makes up our propulsion systems, with a particular focus on the Thrust Chamber Assembly(TCA). You will own parts from initial CAD layout through to final stress justification, working hand in hand with the manufacturing and test teams to bring flight hardware from concept to qualified design. Key responsibilities In your capacity as a CAD & Stress Analyst, you will be responsible for the on-time and on-cost design and structural justification of propulsion hardware, with the TCA as your primary scope. Your role will be continuously evolving, but day-to-day responsibilities will include: During the Design Phase: Design the thrust chamber & injector propulsion hardware in CAD, from concept layout through to detailed design. Perform stress analysis (hand calculations and FEA) on designed parts to substantiate margins of safety under mechanical, thermal and pressure loads. Select materials and define manufacturing processes in coordination with manufacturing engineering, accounting for structural, thermal and producibility constraints.

title: Privacy Counsel
locationText: Canada - Remote (ON, AB, BC, or NS Only)
description:
We're transforming the grocery industry

At Instacart, we invite the world to share love through food because we believe everyone should have access to the food they love and more time to enjoy it together. Where others see a simple need for grocery delivery, we see exciting complexity and endless opportunity to serve the varied needs of our community. We work to deliver an essential service that customers rely on to get their groceries and household goods, while also offering safe and flexible earnings opportunities to Instacart Personal Shoppers.

Instacart has become a lifeline for millions of people, and we’re building the team to help push our shopping cart forward. If you’re ready to do the best work of your life, come join our table.

Instacart is a Flex First team

There’s no one-size fits all approach to how we do our best work. Our employees have the flexibility to choose where they do their best work-whether it’s from home, an office, or your favorite coffee shop-while staying connected and building community through regular in-person events. Learn more about our flexible approach to where we work.

Why this role is on the menu

Instacart's global privacy program is scaling rapidly alongside the growth of its e-commerce, advertising, health, and AI-driven product lines, and the regulatory landscape is evolving faster than ever. This role exists to embed privacy into how Instacart builds and operates, ensuring product, engineering, data science, advertising, health, and business development teams have clear, practical guidance as they move quickly. Without this partnership, cross-functional teams lack the legal support needed to navigate complex data governance decisions, from adtech and retail data sharing to AI product development. A year from now, Instacart's privacy program is stronger, more scalable, and recognized as a trusted partner embedded across every part of the business.

 

What you'll cook up in your first year

• Global privacy and data protection developments are actively monitored, with enforcement trends translated into clear, actionable guidance that business stakeholders can act on.

• New products and business initiatives across e-commerce, advertising, health, and AI-driven product lines are reviewed and counseled through privacy requirements, with compliant design embedded from the start.

• Instacart's advertising business operates with clear frameworks for data use, audience targeting, measurement, and consent, including well-governed restrictions on sensitive data in advertising contexts.

• Data sharing arrangements with retail partners, advertisers, vendors, and subsidiaries are assessed and governed, with DPA, BAA, and cross-border transfer mechanisms (SCCs, DPF) in place.

• Privacy program operations are strengthened: PRAs and DPIAs are supported, intake and documentation processes run effectively, and standard guidance, templates, playbooks, and training materials make privacy requirements accessible and scalable across the organization.

 

The secret ingredients we're looking for

Must-have pantry staples (Minimum Qualifications)

• J.D. from a top-tier law school; membership in at least one U.S. state bar (California required or ability to register as in-house counsel)

• 6+ years of experience focused on privacy and data protection, at a leading law firm, in-house, or both

• Deep working knowledge of CCPA, GDPR, HIPAA, and the evolving landscape of U.S. state privacy and health data laws

• Experience advising on adtech, data sharing, and consumer data use in a retail, e-commerce, or platform environment

• Strong ability to translate complex legal requirements into practical, business-oriented guidance for non-legal stakeholders

Optional garnishes (Preferred Qualifications)

• Experience with AI governance and privacy-by-design in ML/AI product development

• Experience in AdTech

title: Sales Representative (m/w/d) - Köln
description:
Du hast erste Vertriebserfahrung und willst jetzt richtig loslegen? Bei uns bekommst du ein strukturierteres Onboarding, dein eigenes Gebiet, kurze Sales-Cycles und ein Team, das dich weiterentwickelt.

Salonkee ist Marktführer für Salon-Software in Luxemburg, Belgien und der Schweiz. Über 10.000 Beauty- und Wellness-Betriebe in sieben Ländern nutzen unsere All-in-one-Software - von der Terminbuchung über die Kundenverwaltung und die Kasse bis hin zu Marketing- und KI-Funktionen.

Für einen Salon bedeutet das im Schnitt 70% weniger Terminausfälle und 8 bis 12 Stunden weniger Verwaltungsaufwand pro Woche.

DEINE ROLLE

- Du gehst aktiv auf Saloninhaber:innen in deiner Region zu - telefonisch, per Walk-in oder über Social Media (Kaltakquise).

- Vor Ort ermittelst du den Bedarf des Salons mithilfe von Fragen und zeigst anhand von Produktdemos, wie Salonkee den Alltag vereinfachen kann.

- Du verantwortest deinen eigenen Funnel vom Erstkontakt bis zum Abschluss.

- Du planst deine Woche eigenverantwortlich, mit klaren Zielen und einer Führungskraft, die dich unterstützt und weiterentwickelt.

DAS BRINGST DU MIT

- Nachweisbare erste Erfahrung im Vertrieb, idealerweise mit Outbound-Anteil (Kaltakquise, Walk-ins, eigene Terminierung).

- Du bist kontaktfreudig und gehst gerne in den Austausch - egal ob am Telefon oder direkt vor Ort.

- Du bist in der Lage, Menschen zu begeistern und Interessen zu wecken.

- Du kannst mit Ablehnung umgehen und richtest den Blick nach vorn.

- Du bist lernbereit, setzt Feedback um und willst dich weiterentwickeln.

- Du bist strukturiert und organisiert.

- Du bist sicher im Umgang mit digitalen Tools.

- Verhandlungssicheres bis muttersprachliches Deutsch sowie gute Englischkenntnisse.

- Führerschein der Klasse B und Freude daran, in deiner Region unterwegs zu sein.

DAS ERWARTET DICH BEI UNS

- Ein Team vor Ort: Team Lead und Kolleg:innen in deiner Region - du startest nicht allein.

- Strukturierte Einarbeitung und praxisnahe Begleitung über die ersten Monate hinweg (Ramp-Up Programm).

- Ein klarer Entwicklungspfad: Von Junior- über Senior- und bis hin zu Führungsrollen..

- Klare KPIs & Performance-Transparenz, damit du jederzeit weißt, wo du stehst.

- Eigenverantwortliche Wochenplanung und Vertrauensarbeitszeit.

- Firmenwagen inkl. Tankkarte sowie MacBook und iPhone.

- 50 € steuerfreies Guthaben pro Monat über Probonio.

- Fixgehalt und ungedeckelte Provision.

- Teamevents, die den Namen verdienen: Sommerfest, Winterfeier und regelmäßige Team-Formate.

WIE GEHT ES WEITER?

1. Bewerbung & Sichtung - wir melden uns so schnell wie möglich bei dir.

2. Erstgespräch mit unserem Recruiting-Team (ca. 30-45 Minuten).

3. Video-Call mit deiner künftigen Führungskraft.

4. Field Day - zwei Stunden bei uns im Office. Du siehst, wie wir arbeiten, wir sehen dich in Aktion.

5. Abschlussgespräch mit unserer Head of Sales.

Salonkee steht für Chancengleichheit und Vielfalt. Wir freuen uns über Bewerbungen von Menschen mit unterschiedlichen Hintergründen, Perspektiven und Fähigkeiten - unabhängig von Geschlecht, Herkunft, Alter, Behinderung, Religion oder Identität.

title: Principal Software Engineer - Java/Polygot
description:
Location: Remote. Candidates must currently reside in one of the following states: Alabama, Florida, Georgia, Michigan, Mississippi, Missouri, North Carolina, Oklahoma, Tennessee, Texas, or Virginia.
Employment type: Full-time
Work authorization: Must be authorized to work in the U.S. without visa sponsorship
About Tivly
Tivly is one of the largest marketplaces for commercial insurance in the United States, connecting business owners looking to protect their businesses with insurance carriers that fit their needs. Since 2009, Tivly has established a network of over 200 trusted carriers, agents, and brokers serving a wide range of businesses.
About the Role
The Principal Engineer is a highly hands-on technical leadership role at Tivly , responsible for designing, building, and scaling the core software systems that power our technology platform. Reporting directly to the Chief Technology Officer, this role helps define Tivly 's technical direction and drives system architecture decisions. You'll apply modern engineering practices, from microservices architecture and API development to multi-language (polyglot) solutions, to improve performance, reliability, and scalability across our products. Success in this position requires deep technical expertise, strong architectural judgment, and a commitment to mentoring engineers. The goal is high-quality, maintainable software that supports business growth and innovation.
What You'll Do
Architecture & Technical Direction

• Own the architecture and design of distributed systems serving millions of insurance leads and transactions.

• Evaluate new technologies and frameworks to enhance performance and maintainability.

• Contribute to strategic technology roadmap planning and cross-team alignment.

Hands-On Engineering

• Lead by example through hands-on coding, technical reviews, and system optimization.

• Support cross-functional development in multiple languages (e.g., Java, Kotlin, Python, TypeScript, Go).

• Ensure security, reliability, and compliance within all engineering deliverables.

Collaboration & Mentorship

• Collaborate with Product, DevOps, and Data teams on scalable API integrations and microservices.

• Mentor senior and mid-level engineers, fostering a high-performing and collaborative environment.

Additional Responsibilities & Metrics

• Perform other related duties, ad hoc tasks, and special projects as assigned to support departmental and organizational goals.

• Consistently meet and maintain the established metrics and performance standards. Your direct supervisor and the organization set these standards and update them periodically to match changing business needs.

What You Bring

• 7+ years of professional software engineering experience, including significant time in backend or platform roles.

• Advanced proficiency in Java, plus hands-on experience with at least one additional language such as Kotlin, Python, Go, or TypeScript.

• Proven track record designing, building, and scaling distributed systems and microservice-based architectures in a high-traffic environment.

• Strong experience with RESTful APIs, event-driven architectures, and integrating with internal and external services.

• Deep understanding of system performance, reliability, and observability (profiling, logging, metrics, alerting).

• Practical experience with cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, GCP, or Azure), containerization (Docker), and orchestration (Kubernetes).

• Familiarity with modern CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, and code quality practices.

• Experience working closely with Product, DevOps, and Data teams to ship features and platform capabilities.

• Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field; equivalent practical experience considered.

Core Competencies

•
Technical Leadership: Guides architecture decisions

• Lead the creative strategy process by originating ad angles, hooks, and scripts that outperform current controls

• Diagnose performance bottlenecks by analyzing the interplay between CPL, CTR, CVR, and CAC to determine if the issue lies in the offer, the funnel, or the creative

• Write comprehensive creative briefs and manage the production workflow independently

• Lead client-facing calls in English, presenting data, insights, and strategic pivots with confidence

• Strong understanding of CPL, CTR, CVR, CAC, cost per booked call, and cost per SQL.

• Must be able to interpret performance data and explain the next action, not simply report metrics.

🌎 Fully remote: Work from anywhere with a flexible schedule.
🚀 Growth-oriented environment: Join a young, creative, and fast-scaling marketing team.

title: Senior Machine Learning Scientist / Machine Learning Scientist (LLM)
description:
We are looking for a Machine Learning Scientist with specific background and skills in the LLM space, who is passionate about applying AI and ML to solve high-impact societal challenges. The ideal candidate will have a strong research background with 3+ years of relevant LLM experience or a PhD in the LLM area, and expertise in designing and implementing machine learning models, data analysis, and simulations. The candidate should have expertise beyond building RAG systems and prompt engineering. They should be skilled in mentoring junior researchers, working in cross-functional teams, and contributing to both practical deployments and academic research. A demonstrated commitment to social good, strong communication skills, and the ability to translate complex problems into deployable ML solutions are essential.

• As an ML Scientist, you will be responsible for building machine learning solutions to problems of societal importance and mentoring other team members in this effort. You will participate in stakeholder engagements, setting critical requirements, problem definition, and the development and execution of algorithms and solutions to the problems.

• To apply machine learning and related technologies for social good, you will need to understand user challenges and their context, curate and transform data, train and validate models, create evaluations and benchmarks, run simulations, and broadly derive insights from data. In doing so, you will work in cross-functional teams spanning engineering, solutions, domain experts, and designers. You will also work closely with social sector organisations and are encouraged to collaborate with researchers across the world.

• You will be encouraged to drive fundamental advances to the technology domains themselves as part of the efforts towards their application, present your work in technical and other forums of interest, and publish in leading conferences and journals.

• Excellence as an individual contributor goes together with good teamwork and collaboration. You will mentor junior researchers, post-docs, and interns, and participate in recruiting and hiring activities. You will also be expected to interact with external partners when required, and to make periodic visits to the communities from where challenges are derived and where the solutions will be deployed.

Requirements

• Bachelor’s degree or equivalent in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Statistics, Applied Mathematics, Physics, Economics or a relevant quantitative field with relevant work experience of 6+ years OR a Master’s degree in these fields with 4+ years of relevant experience OR a Ph.D. in Machine Learning with a focus on LLMs from a reputed institute.

• We are looking for ML Scientists with experience applying AI, machine learning, and data science to real-world problems. Ideal candidates should also have a strong research background, have experience in mentoring junior researchers through strong code practices and ideation, and be adept at a variety of data mining/analysis methods and tools, building and implementing models, visualising data, creating/using algorithms, and running simulations. Familiarity with popular deep learning algorithms, transformer architectures, and advances in LLMs or foundation models is required.

• Experience with building and evaluating conversational (multi-turn) chatbots is a plus.

• Candidates should be comfortable working with cross-functional teams, have excellent oral and written communication skills, and a track record of driving projects to completion. Evidence of written skills through high quality research publications is a plus.

• Candidates should be passionate about using their technical skills to solve large societally important problems.

title: Program Manager Cards

Program Manager - Cards

Location: Belgium - Brussels

About Capco

Capco is a global business and technology consultancy specializing in financial services. We help leading financial institutions navigate complex change, improve their operations and deliver transformation across business and technology. Our collaborative and entrepreneurial environment gives you the opportunity to develop your expertise and contribute to projects with a tangible impact.

About the Team

You will join Capco's financial services consulting team and work with business leaders, technology teams and external partners on a major cards program. The assignment involves close collaboration across an international banking group, bringing together stakeholders with different priorities to deliver a coordinated program.

The Role

We are looking for an experienced Program Manager to lead the business delivery of a complex cards program. You will take ownership of program planning, governance and delivery, ensuring that objectives, resources, budgets and dependencies remain aligned.

You will work closely with senior stakeholders, group-level teams and an external service provider. The role calls for someone who can combine a strategic view with disciplined execution, make informed decisions and maintain momentum across multiple projects and teams.

This is a hybrid role based in Brussels, with regular travel to Paris for program and stakeholder meetings.

What You Will Do

• Develop and maintain integrated program plans, aligning milestones, dependencies and delivery priorities across workstreams.

• Establish and manage program governance, including decision-making, escalation and reporting processes.

• Prepare and lead program boards and steering committees, presenting progress, risks and decisions clearly.

• Manage relationships with business and IT stakeholders, international group teams and external suppliers.

• Monitor delivery against scope, timelines and objectives, and coordinate actions to address delays or changing priorities.

• Identify and manage risks, issues and cross-project dependencies.

• Coordinate capacity planning and resource allocation across the program.

• Manage program budgets and business cases, monitoring financial performance and supporting investment decisions.

• Lead and motivate contributors, maintaining clear accountability and a shared focus on outcomes.

What You Will Bring

• At least 10 years of relevant professional experience, including proven responsibility for complex projects or programs involving multiple workstreams.

• A strong understanding of banking operations and the ability to connect business objectives with technology delivery.

• Experience working across business and IT teams, with familiarity with enterprise IT systems and workflow processes.

• Strong knowledge of project and program management methodologies, such as Agile, PRINCE2 or PMBOK, and relevant planning and reporting tools such as Clarity or MS Project.

• Experience managing governance, senior stakeholders, budgets, resources, risks and delivery dependencies.

• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the diplomacy and confidence to align different interests and drive decisions.

• A structured, proactive and results-oriented approach, combined with strategic thinking, commercial awareness and a focus on customer outcomes.

• A master's degree or equivalent professional experience.

Experience in the cards business, including card issuing or processing systems, is a strong advantage. Previous work with BNP Paribas or eWL, or on initiatives that centralize activities onto shared platforms within an international group, is also valuable.

Languages

• Strong written and spoken English, plus professional proficiency in either French or Dutch, is required.

• Knowledge of both French and Dutch is an advantage.

Why Join Capco?

Join an international consultancy where you can lead complex transformation programs

PREFERRED

title: Mechanical Engineer, PCBA Test Infrastructure, Robotics
description:
ABOUT THE TEAM

Our Robotics team is focused on unlocking general-purpose robotics and pushing towards AGI-level intelligence in dynamic, real-world settings. Working across the entire model stack, we integrate cutting-edge hardware and software to explore a broad range of robotic form factors. We strive to seamlessly blend high-level AI capabilities with the constraints of physical systems to improve peoples’ lives.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We are seeking a Mechanical Engineer for a senior individual-contributor role leading printed circuit board assembly (PCBA) test fixtures and infrastructure for advanced robotic systems. You will independently turn evolving requirements into working fixtures, make technical tradeoffs, and own delivery from concept and detailed design through fabrication, validation, deployment, and reliable operation.

This role combines development-lab work with deployment at contract manufacturers. You will build precision mechanical systems for board programming, functional test, and characterization, including board nests, probe plates, connector interfaces, alignment features, clamps, enclosures, and thermal interfaces. You will partner with electrical, firmware, software, manufacturing, and reliability teams to make fixtures repeatable, protective of delicate assemblies, and maintainable as board designs evolve.

This role is based in San Francisco, CA, and requires in-person presence 4 days a week. Travel to contract-manufacturer sites is part of the role, with timing based on build and deployment needs.

IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL:

- Own the mechanical architecture of PCBA test stations, including frames, board nests, datum schemes, access, guarding, ergonomics, and serviceability.

- Design probe and bed-of-nails fixtures, connector-mating mechanisms, board supports, clamps, and interchangeable tooling for programming, functional test, and characterization.

- Use first-principles analysis and simulation to assess stiffness, probe and insertion forces, board deflection, tolerance stacks, thermal growth, and fixture life; validate key predictions on hardware.

- Develop locating and compliance features that accommodate board and assembly variation, protect components and solder joints, and preserve contact repeatability across loading cycles and board revisions.

- Partner with electrical engineers on test-point access, probe selection, connector engagement, ESD provisions, cable routing, cooling, and interlocks; define motion and sequencing constraints with software and controls partners.

- Build, assemble, instrument, and debug fixtures in the lab. Establish acceptance checks for alignment, force, board strain where needed, contact repeatability, and cycle life; separate fixture problems from board failures.

- Design safe loading, pinch-point protection, hard stops, and operator access for manual or actuated fixtures. Make wear components easy to inspect, clean, and replace.

- Manage fabrication partners and component vendors. Release CAD, drawings, bills of materials, tolerance analyses, assembly instructions, inspection plans, and maintenance procedures.

- Own fixture deployment and acceptance at contract manufacturers, including assembly and alignment checks, correlation with lab fixtures, operator training, and troubleshooting. Support replication, board-revision changes, and maintenance through released documentation.

YOU MIGHT THRIVE IN THIS ROLE IF YOU:

- Have strong mechanical intuition for precision interfaces, load paths, compliance, tolerances, and the behavior of delicate electronic assemblies.

- Move readily between analysis, CAD, vendor collaboration, and hands-on assembly and debugging.

- Care about repeatable contact, controlled forces, operator usability, and equipment that others can maintain.

- Take ownership from concept through reliable daily operation, adapting fixtures to evolving boards and communicating clearly across electrical, software, manufacturing, and operations team

Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

Position Summary

Anduril's real estate portfolio covers 10M sq ft of R&D labs, manufacturing hubs, and offices worldwide. As Execution & Portfolio Management Lead, you'll run our LOI and lease negotiations and manage a portion of the existing portfolio.

You'll report to the Director of Strategic Real Estate. When the Investments team reaches LOI on a new site, you'll take over and lead the negotiation through lease execution. You'll also own a set of existing sites, including renewals, in-building expansions, terminations, and the landlord relationships, and you'll work directly with the division teams who use that space.

This is a senior negotiation and portfolio strategy role, not lease administration or space planning. We're looking for someone who has led a large number of office and industrial lease negotiations and can judge which terms matter most for a given site and business need. The role has room to grow as the portfolio does.

Key Responsibilities

• Lead LOI and lease negotiations for new sites, renewals, expansions, and amendments across office, R&D, and industrial/manufacturing space, working with Investments, Legal, outside brokers, and Design & Construction.

• Standardize how Anduril leases space. Build and maintain template LOIs and lease forms, and set our standard positions and acceptable fallbacks on key terms.

• Manage a portion of the existing portfolio. Own renewals, in-building expansions, contractions, terminations, and subleases, and bring a recommendation on each well before the decision date.

• Own landlord relationships for your sites and resolve issues as they come up.

• Serve as the main real estate contact for division stakeholders at your sites. Understand how each team uses its space and what it will need next, and use that to shape renewal and expansion decisions.

• Track expirations, option and notice dates, termination rights, and other portfolio events, and start decisions early enough to keep our leverage with landlords.

• Work with the planning team to make sure lease decisions line up with the demand forecast.

• Hand signed deals off to Design & Construction for delivery, and stay involved where lease terms affect the build.

• Report on portfolio status and present recommendations to leadership.

Qualifications and Requirements

• Bachelor's degree in Real Estate, Finance, Business Administration, Urban Planning, or a related field.

• 7+ years of experience in corporate real estate transactions, tenant or landlord representation, or real estate development or asset management.

• A record of leading office and industrial lease negotiations from LOI through execution, including renewals and expansions.

• Detailed knowledge of commercial lease terms, including TI allowances, renewal and expansion options, ROFO/ROFR, termination rights, operating expense provisions, restoration, and holdover.

• Strong financial analysis of lease options, including net effective rent and NPV comparisons, in Excel.

• Experience working with legal counsel on lease drafting and with brokers on market strategy.

• Ability to travel up to 25% for site visits and landlord meetings.

• U.S. citizenship required; eligibility for security clearance preferred.

A model can perform well on benchmarks and still struggle in production. That’s why investing in research, realistic evaluations, and robust verification is critical.

Mercor is seeking to fund AI research on the economic impacts of AI. - Tier 2: under $200,000: Suited to substantial projects requiring dedicated personnel time, meaningful compute, or data collection. Reviewed with proportionally greater attention to the budget breakdown and implementation plan.

- Tier 3: under $500,000: Reserved for ambitious, multi-component research programs. These applications receive the highest level of scrutiny: reviewers will expect a detailed justification of each spend category, a clear account of team capacity to execute at this scale, and milestones against which progress can be assessed.

The level of review scrutiny scales with the size of the ask, so applicants should request the smallest budget that credibly supports the proposed work.

Successful candidates will interview with both our non-profit partner organizations and Stand Together Fellowships staff, so we strongly encourage you to begin the admissions process early!

The Empire Center is looking for talented individuals for our Student Fellow role. Working as a student fellow at the Empire Center provides a unique work experience at a leading state-based think tank.
 
The Empire Center is dedicated to making New York a better place to live and work by promoting public policy reforms grounded in free-market principles, personal responsibility, and the ideals of effective and accountable government. Through research papers, policy briefings, commentaries and conferences, the think tank seeks to educate and inform New York State policymakers, news media and the general public.
 
The Empire Center’s student fellows are paired with Empire Center researchers whose focuses include taxes, government transparency, education, energy and healthcare.
 
Student fellows will learn analysis skills and apply them on important projects with the goal of being named author on an Empire Center report or other publication sharing their findings.
 
A strong applicant will have experience with Microsoft Excel, extremely strong attention to detail, and a proven record of working independently.
 
This role is full-time and may be performed in person at our Albany, NY office or remotely.

Machinify is rebuilding how health plans audit and pay claims - at scale, with AI. Claims mapping & transformation - Design and implement data transformations that convert raw medical and institutional claims (837 EDI, UB-04, CMS-1500) into Machinify 's canonical models, applying healthcare coding standards (ICD-10-CM/PCS, CPT, HCPCS) throughout.

title: Research Scientist / Research Engineer, Search Integrity
description:
ABOUT THE TEAM

The Foundations Research team works on high-risk, high-reward ideas that could shape the next decade of AI. Our goal is to advance the science and data that enable our training and scaling efforts, with a particular focus on future frontier models. We push the boundaries of data, scaling laws, optimization techniques, model architectures, model + search co-design and efficiency improvements to propel our science.

The Search team sits within Foundations, building agentic search by co-designing model-system interfaces with the core search stack: serving, indexing, and retrieval. We research and develop large-scale systems that transform and index vast corpora, enabling models to most effectively find and reason over information. In close partnership with researchers, we bring modeling advances into production and improve how AI systems discover, retrieve, and use knowledge.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We’re looking for a Researcher to lead Search Integrity: the systems that distinguish useful web content from spam, manipulation, and other adversarial or low-quality material.

The challenge extends beyond evaluating individual pages. A page may appear credible in isolation, while its links, metadata, or relationships with other sites reveal coordinated manipulation. As AI makes convincing content easier to produce at scale, detection systems must adapt to increasingly sophisticated adversaries.

You’ll define the technical approach, build classifiers and evaluations, and shape how integrity signals influence what Search indexes and retrieves. Working closely with Search and broader Safety and Integrity teams, you’ll use frontier models to advance detection methods and bring them into production.

RESPONSIBILITIES

- Define the technical direction for Search Integrity, identifying gaps and determining which problems and interventions to prioritize.

- Develop AI and ML systems to detect spam, scams, phishing, malicious domains, prompt injections, and other adversarial or low-quality web content.

- Discover useful signals across page content, links, domains, metadata, and relationships between websites, including patterns that reveal coordinated manipulation.

- Build evaluations that measure detection quality and how integrity interventions affect the information Search surfaces.

- Translate detection signals into indexing, ranking, and filtering decisions, improving what models can retrieve and rely on.

- Serve as the technical owner for integrity within Search, partnering with researchers, engineers, and broader Safety and Integrity teams to build and deploy these systems.

YOU MIGHT THRIVE IN THIS ROLE IF YOU HAVE

- Deep experience in web spam, search quality, adversarial content detection, or related integrity problems at scale.

- Strong applied ML and research skills, with experience developing classifiers, detection methods, and evaluations for real-world systems.

- An understanding of how adversaries manipulate content and links, coordinate across sites, and adapt to detection systems.

- A track record of independently defining ambiguous technical problems and driving solutions from experimentation through production.

- Experience working across research, engineering, and integrity teams while remaining hands-on with technical work.

- A first-principles approach to using frontier models and compute, and a strong interest in keeping detection systems effective as adversaries evolve.

About OpenAI

OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity.

title: Staff Platform Engineer
description:
MEET DEEPL

DeepL is a global AI product and research company focused on building secure, intelligent solutions to complex business problems. Over 200,000 business customers and millions of individuals across 228 global markets today trust DeepL's Language AI platform for human-like translation, improved writing and real-time voice translation.
Founded in 2017 by CEO Jaroslaw “Jarek” Kutylowski, DeepL now has around 1,000 passionate employees and is supported by world-renowned investors including Benchmark, IVP, and Index Ventures.

Our goal is to become the global leader in trusted, intelligent AI technology, building products that drive better communication, foster connections, and create a meaningful impact. To achieve this, we need talented people like you to join our journey. If you’re ready to shape the future of AI and grow your career in a fast-moving, purpose-driven environment, DeepL is your next destination.

WHAT SETS US APART

What sets us apart is our blend of cutting-edge AI technology, meaningful work, and a culture where people truly thrive. We’re a team of innovators, researchers, and creators driven by a shared purpose to unlock human potential by making work simpler, smarter, and more connected.

When we share what it’s like to work at DeepL, the reactions are overwhelmingly positive. This might be because of our technology that helps millions of people and businesses communicate and work better every day, or because of the trust, curiosity, and care that shape our culture.

What we know for sure is this: being part of DeepL means joining a team dedicated to innovation, growth, and well-being. Discover more about life at DeepL onLinkedIn https://www.linkedin.com/company/deepl/,Instagram https://www.instagram.com/deepl_official/, and our Blog https://www.deepl.com/en/blog.

 

MEET THE TEAM BEHIND THIS JOURNEY

You will join the Hybrid Platform Engineering track, which builds and operates the compute layer underpinning DeepL's products and research: the Kubernetes control plane, node lifecycle, networking, storage and core cluster services, across both on-prem and cloud infrastructure. Today that spans hybrid infrastructure in Europe - including large on-prem GPU clusters powering DeepL's research and hundreds of on-prem GPU nodes serving production inference - as well as AWS regions across the globe running the product. The track is deepening this hybrid model, unifying how workloads run across on-prem hardware and AWS to give product and research teams a self-service foundation they can build on.

 

YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

- Take ownership of the reliability, capacity and cost efficiency of DeepL's compute infrastructure, CPU and GPU: the hybrid platform serving our products across AWS and on-prem, and the on-prem clusters powering our research, including their hardware lifecycle

- Shape the platform's architecture: bring strong technical positions, weigh them on their merits with your peers, and commit to decisions serving the best outcome

- Design, build and operate production-grade Kubernetes clusters across cloud and on-prem infrastructure, taking them from design through to long-term operation

- Drive the technical work of deepening the hybrid model - unifying how workloads run across on-prem hardware and cloud, especially AWS and supporting research as it adopts cloud-native technology and ways of working

- Define infrastructure-as-code and platform standards that hold across the track, and strengthen observability and security so the platform's behaviour is legible to the teams that depend on it

- Mentor engineers across the infrastructure track and raise the technical bar of the group, through design reviews, architecture decisions and the everyday habits that keep the platform maintainable

- Build consensus across engineering teams and turn it into shipped change, shaping platform direction at track level

- Lead incident response for hybrid infrastructure, driving remediation through to roo

title: Accounting Manager — AI & Automation
description:
Are you an accounting leader who is obsessed with AI?
We're looking for an experienced accountant who believes AI is going to fundamentally change how accounting gets done - and wants to be at the forefront of that transformation. Arboreal manages more than 10,000 apartments, and we've built our own property-management software platform, Maynard, with extensive APIs and MCP tools that let AI agents work directly in our accounting systems. This role is your chance to prove how much more a great accountant can accomplish when the manual work is handed to AI and the judgment stays with you.
The Role
This is a new kind of accounting role, built for how Arboreal intends to run its accounting function going forward. Rather than managing a team of people, the Accounting Manager oversees the accounting for a book of work primarily through AI agents operating on Maynard in conjunction with AppFolio. The focus is judgment and review: directing and supervising automated workflows, tackling complex reconciliations and investigations with AI, preparing and reviewing journal entries, validating what the agents produce, and standing behind the accuracy of the financials. You'll be one of four Accounting Managers who work side by side to make sure financials go out on time and accurately and that balances are reconciled across the portfolio. A shared pool of accountants performs a limited set of manual tasks and AI-assisted supporting reconciliations; these accountants do not report to this role. You'll have direct access to the CFO, the engineering team, and our AI-enabled accounting tools - and you'll be encouraged to experiment, improve processes, and figure out how much more is possible. This position reports directly to the Chief Financial Officer and spans accounts payable and receivable, corporate accounting, client onboarding and offboarding, and the review of property financials.
Oversee Accounting Through AI Agents & Automation

• Own the accounting for an assigned book of work, executed primarily through AI agents running on Maynard alongside AppFolio - directing, supervising, and quality-controlling their output rather than performing each task by hand.

• Use AI to tackle complex reconciliations, investigate accounting problems, and automate work that traditionally takes hours of manual effort.

• Prepare and review journal entries and reconciliations, and review AI- and system-generated entries and reports for accuracy, completeness, proper coding, and compliance with U.S. GAAP before they are relied upon.

• Identify, investigate, and resolve exceptions the agents flag or that review surfaces, and determine when a human needs to step in.

• Experiment with and improve agent workflows, prompts, rules, and controls - partnering with the CFO and engineering team so the system produces reliable results and keeps getting better.

• Act as a knowledgeable check on automation - understanding what the agents are doing well enough to catch when an output is wrong, and never signing off on numbers that have not been verified.

Timely & Accurate Financial Reporting

• Work alongside the other three Accounting Managers to ensure financial statements go out on time and accurately for the assigned portfolio each period.

• Coordinate the close calendar and hand-offs across the manager group so there are no gaps or duplicated work, and so dependencies are met.

• Support monthly, quarterly, and annual close and produce financials in accordance with U.S. GAAP.

• Provide the CFO with variance explanations, supporting schedules, and management reporting for lenders, owners, and external tax preparers and auditors.

Reconciliations & Balance Integrity

• Ensure balance-sheet accounts are reconciled and that balances are supported, reviewing the AI-assisted reconciliations prepared on the platform and by the accountant pool.
